description: Platform/middleware validation suite for the shared payment-engine (Spring Boot). Cucumber/Gherkin .feature files run with behave against the live middleware posture service. Validates the platform team's responsibilities: shared dependency BOM (Log4Shell/Spring4Shell/deserialization), JVM Log4Shell mitigations, TLS hardening, secrets-in-config, and actuator exposure. Some checks pass (JVM baseline, HTTPS) and the patch's regressions fail.

entries.name: Dependency CVE Scan (shared library BOM)
entries.description: Flags Log4Shell / Spring4Shell / commons-collections in the payment-engine dependency BOM.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Log4Shell Runtime Mitigations (JVM)
entries.description: Asserts formatMsgNoLookups is set and JNDI remote-codebase loading is disabled.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: TLS Hardening (connector)
entries.description: HTTPS enabled and legacy TLS protocols (TLSv1/1.1) refused.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: No Secrets in Configuration
entries.description: Datasource credentials must not be hardcoded in application.properties.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Management Endpoint Exposure
entries.description: Actuator/management endpoints must not be exposed wide open.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: JVM Runtime Baseline
entries.description: Heap and truststore are configured (passes on the patched build).
entries.author: Java Platform Team
